title: The Precious stone in the ring
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：precious　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 precious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the teacher wrote of ① a precious stone in the ring in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② more precious than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the precious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most precious stone in the ring anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too precious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the precious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a precious time before the rains, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as precious as the time before the rains they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was precious or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something precious, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite precious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the precious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, on the same day, she wrote of another precious stone in the ring in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more precious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most precious time before the rains in the whole classroom, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the precious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 珍贵（前置定语 a precious stone in the ring：1950 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件珍贵的宝石）
B. adj. 珍贵／宝贵（比较级 more precious than：文中两处，一处比戒指上的宝石，一处比预想）
C. adj. 珍贵／宝贵（最高级 the most precious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 珍贵（表语 too precious to do：母亲觉得它太珍贵，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 宝贵（前置定语 a precious time before the rains：叔叔把整件事称作一桩宝贵的时间）
F. adj. 宝贵（同级比较 as precious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的宝贵时间相比）
G. adj. 宝贵（后置定语 something precious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 宝贵（受程度副词修饰 quite precious：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a precious stone in the ring
the most precious stone in the ring anybody
a precious time before the rains
The most precious time before the rains in

answers.why: precious 意为“珍贵”，1950 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件珍贵的宝石”，此处作前置定语 a precious stone in the ring。
precious 意为“珍贵”，此处用比较级 more precious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
precious 意为“珍贵”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最珍贵的一件，故用最高级 the most precious stone in the ring。
precious 意为“珍贵”，母亲认为这件东西“太珍贵了，谁也用不上”，too precious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
precious 意为“宝贵”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩宝贵的时间”，此处作前置定语 a precious time before the rains。
precious 意为“宝贵”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的宝贵时间一样宝贵”，同级比较用 as precious as。
precious 意为“宝贵”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“宝贵的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something precious。
precious 意为“宝贵”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当宝贵”，quite 修饰原级 precious。
precious 意为“宝贵”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要宝贵”，故用比较级 more precious than。
precious 意为“宝贵”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个教室里最宝贵的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most precious time before the rains。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件珍贵的宝石。（a precious stone in the ring）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更珍贵。（more precious than …）
母亲觉得它太珍贵，谁也用不上。（too precious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩宝贵的时间。（a precious time before the rains）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的宝贵时间一样宝贵。（as precious as …）
到了 1957 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件宝贵的东西。（something precious）
answers: In 1950 the teacher wrote of a precious stone in the ring in the notebook.
Everybody said it was more precious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too precious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a precious time before the rains.
He said nobody would call it as precious as the time before the rains they had once had.
By 1957 the notebook asked for nothing but something precious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 precious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the teacher wrote of a precious stone in the ring in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most precious stone in the ring in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too precious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a precious time before the rains, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite precious, and everybody laughed.
The precious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
